name: The Americana at Brand
summary: Posh mall offers high-end retailers, eateries, a theater & electric trolley, plus a landscaped park.
description: The Americana at Brand in Glendale, California, is a one-of-a-kind destination that offers a remarkable blend of shopping, restaurants, activities, movies, and entertainment. Located just a short drive from Downtown Los Angeles and Hollywood, this premier outdoor center features upscale retail, dining experiences, AMC Theatres, and signature events including seasonal celebrations and live entertainment. With amenities like valet parking, concierge services, and the exclusive Caruso Signature membership program, The Americana at Brand delivers a sophisticated shopping experience in an architectically stunning environment.
demographics: The Americana at Brand attracts an affluent, fashion-conscious demographic primarily consisting of upper-middle to high-income households from Glendale, Pasadena, and surrounding Los Angeles communities. The visitor base skews toward young professionals, families with children, and tourists, with household incomes typically exceeding $100,000 annually. Shoppers are drawn to the center's upscale retail mix and experiential amenities, demonstrating strong preferences for premium brands, elevated dining experiences, and entertainment-oriented shopping trips that combine leisure activities with retail.
